selection: Twelve previously unused merged source changes selected from the next chronological metadata page. Inputs span runtime policy, issue ownership, JSON Schema conversion, cyclic parsing, types, performance, API compatibility, and presentation. No fixing diff was opened before freezing.

cases.issue: Optional, defaulted, and required inputs are conflated by one optin state, and transforms compensate with a fallback payload flag. Represent the three rungs directly so partial objects keep values supplied by an intervening default without runtime flag repair.

Check-originated issues expose the check in inst but not the schema that owns it, preventing error maps from reading the schema's metadata. Carry the owning schema on raw issues consistently across schema- and check-originated errors.
fromJSONSchema ignores the hostname string format and falls back to a plain string even though a hostname validator exists. Map the format and preserve clean JSON Schema round trips.

Parsing an input object containing a reference cycle overflows even through safeParse. Add opt-in memoized container allocation so supported cyclic inputs reproduce their reference topology without adding parse-path work to schemas that do not request it.

Input-mode JSON Schema emission marks a required preprocessed object property as optional because the pipe inherits optin from its transform input. Resolve requiredness through the preprocessing pipe to its inner output schema without changing runtime optin.

Add a cycle-safe deepPartial implementation using schema definition types rather than brittle instanceof switches, and expose runtime input and output helpers while preserving custom and recursive schema behavior.

Loose records with closed enum or literal key schemas still report unrecognized keys because only the open-key validation path honors loose mode. Pass through extra keys consistently on the closed-key path.

Registry JSON Schema conversion repeatedly rescans the shared seen map during extractDefs and finalize, making work quadratic in registry size. Guard the shared passes by external-registry identity while preserving repeated generator calls and non-external conversions.

fromJSONSchema models propertyNames as a record and short-circuits patternProperties and additionalProperties. Validate raw key names with an identity guard so all object keywords compose and declared properties keep their own value schemas.

Mini merge advertises a schema-to-schema signature but forwards the second schema to a shape-only utility and throws. Use schema merge behavior, match classic configuration precedence, and explain invalid plain-shape calls.
The English locale ignores the exact flag on too_small and too_big issues, so fixed length and size checks render range wording. Emit exact wording for string, array, set, and map constraints.

fromJSONSchema splits local reference pointers but looks up raw RFC 6901 tokens, breaking ids containing slash or tilde. Decode pointer segments in the correct replacement order before resolving definitions.
